objects.name: Demo card (placeholder)
objects.riddle: PLACEHOLDER: the riddle team will write this. For now, point your camera at targets/source/00-demo-card.png on another screen.
objects.hint: Open the demo card image on a laptop and aim your phone at it.

objects.name: Sneakers
objects.riddle: I spy a pair that never walks alone, laced up tight and built for speed.

objects.name: Label Maker
objects.riddle: I spy a little printer that names everything it meets, one sticky strip at a time.

objects.name: 1950s Car
objects.riddle: I spy a ride with chrome and fins, straight out of the days of drive-in films.

objects.name: Smart Watch
objects.riddle: I spy a tiny screen you wear, counting your steps and telling the hour.

objects.name: Tennis Racket
objects.riddle: I spy a frame strung tight with a grid, ready to send a fuzzy ball flying.

objects.name: Midcentury Modern Chair
objects.riddle: I spy a leather seat with its own footrest, the comfiest spot to read in the room.

objects.name: Toilet Paper
objects.riddle: I spy a soft roll that everyone needs and nobody wants to run out of.

objects.name: Backpack
objects.riddle: I spy a bag with two straps that rides on your back to every class.

objects.name: Fish Aquarium
objects.riddle: I spy a glass box with a whole underwater world swimming inside.

objects.name: Hose
objects.riddle: I spy a long green snake that sleeps in a coil and sprays when it wakes.

objects.name: Sunglasses
objects.riddle: I spy two dark windows you wear on your face when the sun gets too bright.

objects.name: Umbrella
objects.riddle: I spy a roof you can carry, opening wide whenever the clouds start to cry.

objects.name: Drone
objects.riddle: I spy a flyer with four spinning blades and no pilot on board.

objects.name: Washing Machine
objects.riddle: I spy a round glass door where clothes go for a spin.

objects.name: Bicycle Helmet
objects.riddle: I spy a hard shell with vents on top that keeps a rider's head safe.

objects.name: Boombox
objects.riddle: I spy a box with two big speakers and a handle, made for music on the move.

objects.name: Handheld Fan
objects.riddle: I spy pleats that open into a half moon and make a breeze with a flick of the wrist.

objects.name: Electric Scooter
objects.riddle: I spy two small wheels, a tall handle and a deck to stand on, zipping across campus.

objects.name: Rice Cooker
objects.riddle: I spy a pot with a lid that pops open when the grains are fluffy and done.

objects.name: Toothbrush
objects.riddle: I spy a buzzing stick that keeps your smile clean twice a day.

objects.name: Art Nouveau Desk Lamp
objects.riddle:
I spy a dome with petals of glass,
On a long, thin stem, with a look from the past.
My shade curves down and my stand stays tall,
I give off a glow when the night starts to fall.

objects.name: Comb
objects.riddle: I spy a row of thin teeth that never bite, only tame your hair.

objects.name: Headphones
objects.riddle: I spy two cushioned cups joined by a band that hush the world and play your songs.

objects.name: Contemporary Robot
objects.riddle: I spy a modern machine shaped like a person, standing tall and waving hello.

objects.name: Portable Power Station
objects.riddle: I spy a box full of outlets that brings electricity wherever you go.

objects.name: Electric Kettle
objects.riddle: I spy a jug that clicks off when the water is boiling.

objects.name: African Drums
objects.riddle: I spy a goblet-shaped drum that sings when you slap its skin.

objects.name: Astronaut Helmet
objects.riddle: I spy a round helmet with a golden visor, ready for a walk in space.

objects.name: Toaster
objects.riddle: I spy a box with two slots that pops up breakfast when it's golden.

objects.name: Drill
objects.riddle: I spy a tool with a trigger and a spinning bit that makes holes in a hurry.

objects.name: Japanese Toy Robot
objects.riddle: I spy a blocky toy robot from the 80s, red and blue and ready for battle.

objects.name: Coffee Grinder
objects.riddle: I spy a machine that crunches beans before the morning brew.

objects.name: Pinball Machine
objects.riddle: I spy a tilted table of lights and bumpers where a silver ball bounces.

objects.name: Pet Carrier
objects.riddle: I spy a little house with a barred door for a furry friend on the go.

objects.name: Spatula, Spoon, Fork
objects.riddle: I spy kitchen tools that went sailing: a spatula sail, a spoon oar and a fork rudder.

objects.name: Suitcase
objects.riddle: I spy a stack of travel trunks with buckles and handles, packed for an adventure.

objects.name: Crystal Ball
objects.riddle: I spy a glass globe on a stand that claims to know your future.

objects.name: Flashlight
objects.riddle: I spy a tube that throws a beam of light into the dark.

objects.name: Air Purifier
objects.riddle: I spy a quiet tower that breathes in dusty air and breathes out clean.

objects.name: Telescope
objects.riddle: I spy a long tube on three legs that brings the stars up close.

objects.name: Car Tire
objects.riddle: I spy a round rubber wheel with deep treads that grips the road.

objects.name: Rain Jacket
objects.riddle: I spy a hooded coat that laughs at the rain.

objects.name: Radio
objects.riddle: I spy an Art Deco radio shaped like a building, with knobs on top and music inside.

objects.name: Vacuum
objects.riddle: I spy a hungry machine with a long hose that gobbles up dust.

objects.name: Baby Stroller
objects.riddle: I spy a buggy with a push handle, carrying the smallest passenger in town.

objects.name: Lamp
objects.riddle:
I spy stacked blocks rising straight and tall,
With one bare bulb shining over them all.
My geometric tower is simple and bright,
Find the sharp-edged stack that holds up the light.

objects.name: Wireless Earbuds
objects.riddle: I spy two tiny speakers with no wires that tuck into your ears.

objects.name: Camping Lantern
objects.riddle: I spy a glowing lantern that lights up the campsite after dark.

objects.name: Vinyl Record Player
objects.riddle: I spy a spinning platter and a needle arm that plays a song from grooves.

objects.name: Movie Camera
objects.riddle: I spy an old camera on a tripod with two big film reels on top.

objects.name: Beard Trimmer
objects.riddle: I spy a buzzing tool with tiny teeth that keeps a beard in shape.

objects.name: Bread Maker
objects.riddle: I spy a box that kneads and bakes a whole loaf on its own.

objects.name: Paint Roller Kit
objects.riddle: I spy a fuzzy roller and a tray, ready to give a wall a new color.

objects.name: Espresso Machine
objects.riddle: I spy a shiny machine that pulls a tiny, mighty cup of coffee.

objects.name: Gaming Mouse
objects.riddle: I spy a glowing clicker that fits in your palm and wins the game.

objects.name: TV Screen
objects.riddle: I spy an old TV on legs with a roller coaster riding on its roof.

objects.name: Trumpet
objects.riddle: I spy a brass horn with three valves that plays a loud fanfare.

objects.name: Pan
objects.riddle: I spy a heavy black pan with a long handle that sizzles on the stove.

objects.name: Bicycle
objects.riddle: I spy two wheels, pedals and a seat, the classic way to ride.

objects.name: Office Chair
objects.riddle: I spy a grand chair with carved arms, fit for the boss of the office.

objects.name: Tripod
objects.riddle: I spy three thin legs holding a phone steady for the perfect shot.

objects.name: Lock
objects.riddle: I spy a U-shaped lock that keeps a bike from wandering off.

objects.name: Office Desk
objects.riddle: I spy a wide desk where work gets done, with shelves built into its legs.

objects.name: Electric Fan
objects.riddle: I spy a caged set of spinning blades that cools down the room.

objects.name: Motorcycle
objects.riddle: I spy two wheels and a roaring engine, faster than any bicycle.

objects.name: Treadmill
objects.riddle: I spy a moving road that lets you run for miles without leaving the room.
